messages:
anya: Quick intake — new model landed: LlamaX-13B-REV2 (from model-hub). Proposing P0 bring-up focused on quantization selection + fast quality smoke. Plan: export GGUF, run int8 and fp8 calibration, run a 2k-prompt smoke eval vs our redwood/llama-13b baseline. Goal: prefer int8 if quality drop <= 2% and latency/cost wins. Timeline: smoke runs today, deeper eval tomorrow. Any blockers?

kai: +1 on quick smoke. Add canary routing + auto-fallback: if int8 regresses >3% on the eval set, route traffic to fp8 variant. Also run KV-cache perf at seq lengths 512/1024/2048.

sam: I can do export + q-sweep. Which quant libs to test? bitsandbytes (bnb) for int8, and our fp8 kernels from runtime-v2. Need to confirm GGUF flags. Also will validate tokenizer parity. Example commands I’ll run:
```
# export
python export_to_gguf.py --model LlamaX-13B-REV2 --out /tmp/llamax_rev2.gguf
# bnb calibration sweep
python quant_calib.py --input /tmp/llamax_rev2.gguf --mode int8 --calib-set /data/calib/2k.json --out /tmp/q_int8.bin
```

irene: I’ll stand up the eval harness and baseline metrics. Metrics: embed-sim (cosine to baseline), avg logprob, and a task-specific F1/ROUGE on our conv QA set. Also log hallucination rate on safety prompts. Note: include long sequence traces — we’ve seen regressions >1024 tokens before.

ml-bot: job created: jobs/1906240000-llamax-quant-smoke (status: queued). Triggers: export -> int8_calib -> fp8_calib -> smoke_eval.

ops-bot: provisioned: 1xA100-80GB (primary), 2xT4 (parallel regression). Network: VPC-prod-sim.

sam: Posting initial smoke summary (small run, 200 prompts):
```
baseline (redwood/llama-13b): embed-sim=0.892, avg-logprob=-2.31
int8 (bnb): embed-sim=0.878 (-1.6%), avg-logprob=-2.36
fp8 (runtime-v2): embed-sim=0.886 (-0.7%), avg-logprob=-2.33
latency @ A100 (p50): baseline=95ms, int8=72ms, fp8=80ms
cost est: baseline=1.00x, int8=0.72x, fp8=0.78x
```

anya: these look promising — int8 meets our <=2% soft threshold on embed-sim for the quick run. Follow-ups: (1) run full 2k eval overnight, (2) run calibration sensitivity across random seeds, (3) generate adversarial safety set to check hallucination. If any sample shows utility drop >3% on important prompts, we hold canary.

kai: add canary config: route 5% traffic to int8 for 2h, monitor embed-sim delta and error rates via console. If any metric trips >3% degrade or error-rate increase, rollback. I’ll draft rollout config.

irene: I’ll baseline the safety/hallucination numbers tomorrow AM and post. Also will compare generation-token distributions for int8 vs fp8 (to catch degenerate token probs).

anya: note for ops: if int8 shows OOM at seq=2048, fallback to fp8-hybrid profile (keep embedding and attention in fp16, others int8) — that config may be best latency/cost compromise.

ops-bot: noted: add fp8-hybrid as fallback profile and reserve an extra A100 if seq>=2048.

sam: one more: recommend saving calibration artifacts (scale tensors, hist stats) into artifact store with metadata: model-hash, calib-seed, calib-set-hash. Helps reproducibility.

kai: +1. If smoke passes full 2k and safety looks ok, I’ll approve moving to canary later today. :thumbsup:
